data.long_meaning: Shobha is a name derived from the Sanskrit word 'shobhana', which means 'beauty' or 'grace'. This name is often used to describe a person who embodies these qualities. In Hindu mythology, the goddess Saraswati is often referred to as Shobhana, the embodiment of pure knowledge and wisdom. The name Shobha carries the meaning “Beauty, Grace” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Shobha usually hope their child will grow to embody beauty, grace and live with faith, good character and purpose.
